subject: planner: shallow clone the related operator when attach to child task, don't just change the ref pointer plan p. (#61620)
summary: Updates `PhysicalUnionScan.Attach2Task` to shallow-clone `PhysicalSelection`/`PhysicalProjection` before rewiring (projection above union-scan) so the original child task’s plan nodes aren’t mutated when tasks share plan pointers. Adds a regression test (`task_test.go`) and wires it into Bazel.
